plants.name: Mango Tree
plants.description: A tropical fruit tree known for its sweet, juicy mangoes. Grows tall and provides great shade.

plants.name: Jackfruit Tree
plants.description: The largest tree-borne fruit in the world. Nutritious and grows well in tropical climates.

plants.name: Guava Tree
plants.description: Fast-growing fruit tree with delicious vitamin-C rich fruits. Great for home gardens.

plants.name: Royal Poinciana
plants.description: A stunning flowering tree with vibrant red-orange blossoms. One of the most beautiful trees in the world.

plants.name: Cherry Blossom
plants.description: Iconic pink flowering tree that blooms in spring. Symbol of beauty and renewal.

plants.name: Rain Tree
plants.description: A large, wide-canopied shade tree. Perfect for parks and roadsides with its umbrella-like shape.

plants.name: Banyan Tree
plants.description: A majestic tree with aerial roots forming multiple trunks. Provides enormous shade and is sacred in many cultures.

plants.name: Neem Tree
plants.description: A medicinal powerhouse. Every part of the neem tree has healing properties used in traditional medicine.

plants.name: Tulsi Plant
plants.description: Holy basil with powerful antibacterial and medicinal properties. A must-have in every home.

plants.name: Teak Tree
plants.description: A premium timber tree producing highly durable hardwood. Valued worldwide for furniture and construction.

plants.name: Mahogany Tree
plants.description: A prized timber tree with rich reddish-brown wood. Highly sought after for fine furniture.

plants.name: Pine Tree
plants.description: An evergreen conifer that stays lush green year-round. Great for reforestation and carbon capture.

plants.name: Ficus Tree
plants.description: A popular evergreen tree with glossy leaves. Works beautifully both indoors and outdoors.

plants.name: Bougainvillea
plants.description: A vibrant ornamental plant with colorful bracts in pink, red, and purple. Stunning in any garden.

plants.name: Croton Plant
plants.description: A bold ornamental plant with multicolored leaves in red, yellow, and orange. Perfect for decorative landscapes.

plants.name: Golden Bamboo
plants.description: A fast-growing bamboo with striking golden-yellow canes. Ideal for privacy screens and tropical gardens.

plants.name: Giant Bamboo
plants.description: The world's fastest growing plant. Excellent for carbon sequestration, construction, and erosion control.

plants.name: Jasmine Climber
plants.description: A fragrant climbing plant with beautiful white flowers. Fills your garden with a sweet scent.

plants.name: Passion Flower
plants.description: An exotic climbing vine with stunning intricate flowers and edible passion fruit.

plants.name: Lotus Plant
plants.description: A sacred aquatic plant with breathtaking pink and white flowers. Symbolizes purity and enlightenment.

plants.name: Water Lily
plants.description: Elegant floating aquatic plant with vibrant blooms. Perfect for ponds and water gardens.
